decision: Quarantine every scientific row or failure from this program. A terminal may support provider lifecycle and cleanup accounting, and a reached producer exception may support only a harness/context-construction failure; it cannot test BF16 versus FP8 paged KV, attention performance, counters, or the whole-request hurdle.

actual_producer_context.finding: kv_paged_actual.py calls unified_kv_cache_update(key, value, 'h100-local-sentinel') without constructing or registering an Attention layer, KV cache, or layer slot mapping. The exact-image producer first calls get_attention_context(layer_name), so this arbitrary name cannot produce a paged cache update.

actual_selected_paged_backend.finding: The file imports the low-level Triton unified_attention symbol and hashes its source but contains no call to it or to unified_attention_with_output. It constructs no selected backend class. The explicit success-path message says it is refusing the backend call.

local_and_global_c8_geometry.finding: Only two [8,16,256] BF16 tensors are allocated. There is no query tensor, global [8,4,512] input, local/global cache, block_size=16 page geometry, block_table, slot_mapping, seqused_k, sequence lengths, cache dtype, or scale tensor. Required geometry appears only as failure metadata.

matched_bf16_fp8_arms.finding: No FP8 tensor/cache is created and no BF16/FP8 paired arm exists.

output_oracle.finding: There is no attention output, output consumption, cosine similarity, normalized RMSE, or comparison against a nonzero BF16 paged result.

attention_timing.finding: The only CUDA events surround the attempted producer call. No attention call, NVTX range, warmup, paired repetition, arm alternation, p50, synchronized wall timing, or interval-union timing is implemented.

required_counters.finding: No DRAM, L2, cycles, active-warps, launch-count, profiler, or same-NVTX-interval counter capture exists. Missing counter support therefore cannot fail closed.

atomic_sentinel_retrieval.finding: The shared controller can atomically retrieve one stage archive and its typed terminal, but the program cannot emit the two required local/global matched sentinel rows. The retrieved object is necessarily a producer/context failure, not a paged-backend sentinel.

continuation_and_aggregation.finding: h100_owner.py calls controller.run without conditional scripts or a trigger evaluator. There is no c8/c16/c32 sweep, threshold evaluator, context scaling, 50-local/10-global architecture weighting, 358-step aggregation, or 0.027398761575976767 s/request comparison. The top-level acceptance booleans are initialized false and never derived.

adjacent_direct_linear_arm.finding: No direct-linear program is staged; no setup-dominance or seven-minute-reserve trigger is evaluated; no retained conditional is supplied to the controller.

transitive_content_binding.finding: The pre-create artifact hashes current local program/controller bytes and those hashes currently match, while the controller verifies retrieved archive sidecar and internal output manifest. But the benchmark never consumes the staged audit/identity inputs, never records EXPERIMENT_SPEC_SHA256 or RUNTIME_IMAGE_IDENTITY, and the remote manifest hashes outputs rather than staged input bytes. Runtime source hashes alone do not bind selected backend construction or the scientific contract.

provider_lifecycle_and_cleanup_contract.finding: Static owner/controller bytes require a user-systemd durable owner, use one VerifiedRetainedOwner, bind the instance, start an independent watchdog after bind, retrieve a hashed stage archive, and leave context cleanup responsible on failure. Actual cleanup remains a later reconciliation fact and was not polled here.

exposure_and_cost_accounting.finding: The controller derives cost from total controller wall time beginning before instance creation and labels that allocation_seconds; it does not measure authenticated instance exposure separately. The benchmark hard-codes useful_gpu_seconds=0 and records neither setup nor scored GPU time. The derived value may be a conservative cap but is not the exact exposure/useful-GPU accounting required by the brief.

precreate_audit_behavioral_validity.finding: BEHAVIORAL_PRECREATE passes real_call_is_first_cuda_atom by string presence: the source contains an import/name for unified_attention, not an invocation. It also checks absence of two stand-ins without proving the required backend call, geometry, oracle, counters, or trigger. Its pass cannot authorize scientific interpretation.

allowed: Whether provider create/bootstrap/retrieval completed, if later reconciled from typed artifacts
Whether the exact-image producer rejected the absent attention context, if the retrieved diagnostic proves that path
Authenticated cleanup, actual exposure, and derived cost only to the extent later terminal artifacts substantiate them
forbidden: Selected FlashAttention or Triton backend construction or correctness
BF16 versus FP8 accuracy, timing, traffic, or launch-count comparison
Context-scaled byte reduction or whole-request saving

next_action: Reconcile the paid owner only for typed lifecycle, exact failure stage, cost, and cleanup. Do not promote its result as component evidence and do not alter the running owner based on this concurrent audit.
